name: agent-parley
description: Antigravity workspace manifest for the local Agent Parley fork. The project-local coordinate skill symlink was removed on 2026-10-11; its external source and the installed plugin skill exist outside this checkout. The coordinator role neither registers nor requires that skill. Presence on disk does not prove client-session loading. This manifest adds no hooks, MCP servers or permissions; the agent-parley launcher supplies its runtime integration separately.
